--- title: "Data preparation" --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(here::here("chapters", "Rscripts", "00_packages.R")) source(here::here("chapters", "Rscripts", "01_paths.R")) source(here::here("chapters", "Rscripts", "02_read_clean_data.R")) source(here::here("chapters", "Rscripts", "03_filters.R")) source(here::here("chapters", "Rscripts", "15_render_guard.R")) # read-only: never rebuild the database # The cleaned/filtered contrast dataset is cached as an .rds. The book READS it # by default. Set to TRUE only to rebuild the database from the raw PROCEED CSV. rebuild_clean_data <- FALSE clean_path <- here::here("Rdata", "data_clean", "proceed_clean_filtered.rds") ``` ::: This chapter produces the cleaned, filtered contrast dataset (`proceed_clean_filtered.rds`) used throughout the book. By default it **reads the cached file**; the cleaning pipeline below is documentation and only executes when `rebuild_clean_data <- TRUE`. ## Cleaning & filtering pipeline The steps applied when (re)building the dataset: 1. `read_proceed()` - read the raw PROCEED v6.2 rates database. 2. `clean_proceed()` - coerce grouping/categorical variables to factors. 3. `require_lnm_vars()` - keep contrasts with the two-group summary statistics required for $\ln M$: means, standard deviations, and sample sizes for both groups. 4. `filter_generations(max_gen = 300)` - apply the generations <= 300 filter; contrasts with missing generation time are retained. 5. `add_derived_vars()` - add `n_total`, `log10_years`, `log10_generations`. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dat_raw <- read_proceed() dat_clean <- clean_proceed(dat_raw) dat_filtered <- require_lnm_vars(dat_clean) dat_filtered <- filter_generations(dat_filtered, max_gen = 300) dat_lnm_input <- add_derived_vars(dat_filtered) saveRDS(dat_lnm_input, clean_path) cat("Rebuilt and saved cleaned dataset:", nrow(dat_lnm_input), "contrasts\n") ``` ::: ## Load the cleaned dataset ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (!rebuild_clean_data) { pace_need(clean_path, "cleaned dataset") dat_lnm_input <- readRDS(clean_path) cat("Read cached cleaned dataset:", nrow(dat_lnm_input), "contrasts\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Read cached cleaned dataset: 7524 contrasts ``` ::: ::: ## Design coverage ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dat_lnm_input |> dplyr::count(design, sort = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Derived variables ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dplyr::glimpse( dplyr::select(dat_lnm_input, n_total, log10_years, log10_generations) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 7,524 Columns: 3 $ n_total 41, 33, 41, 48, 47, 41, 37, 38, 46, 53, 52, 46, 42, … $ log10_years 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.… $ log10_generations 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.089905, 2.… ``` ::: ::: ## Dataset summary ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dat_lnm_input |> dplyr::summarise( k = dplyr::n(), n_studies = dplyr::n_distinct(ref_id), n_systems = dplyr::n_distinct(sys_id), n_species = dplyr::n_distinct(sp_ncbi), n_allochronic = sum(design == "Allochronic", na.rm = TRUE), n_synchronic = sum(design == "Synchronic", na.rm = TRUE), pct_has_gen = round(100 * mean(!is.na(generations)), 1), pct_has_years = round(100 * mean(!is.na(years) & years > 0), 1) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
